mechanism: Dual-trace memory encoding that pairs each stored fact with a scene trace, recalled across sessions
evidence_scope: we introduce dual-trace memory encoding. In this method, each stored fact is paired with a concrete scene trace, a narrative reconstruction of the moment and context in which the information was learned.
evidence_role: Dual-trace achieves 73.7% overall accuracy versus 53.5%, a +20.2 percentage point (pp) gain
